scripts.build:vercel: npm run typecheck && npm run check:localization && vite build --config vite.vercel.config.ts && node scripts/prune-vercel-assets.mjs
scripts.check:vercel: npm run build:vercel && vitest run tests/vercel-deployment.test.ts && node scripts/check-vercel-preview.mjs
scripts.check:postdeploy: npm run check:vercel-live && npm run check:performance-live
scripts.check:performance-release: npm run check:vercel && npm run check:vercel-live && node scripts/check-performance-release.mjs --require-evidence
scripts.build:all: npm run build:vercel && npm run build:frames
